description: REST API with Che168 (China) used-car listings in JSON: examples in curl, Python, JavaScript and PHP
rules: Send the key in the X-API-Key header; base URL https://api.apiauto.space/v1
Call the API from a server: CORS is off
Paginate with next_cursor; offset is not supported
Paid plans count returned cars; the demo key counts data requests and allows up to 20 cars per request
Che168 listings have no VIN: vin is always null
Photo links expire in about a day: store the car id and fetch a fresh record
